description: This file defines a utility class 'KeywordSearchUtil' with methods for processing search keywords, generating keyword sets from strings, expanding keywords via thesaurus lookups, and handling related configurations. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.common' package and interacts with the OFBiz entity engine.

classes.name: KeywordSearchUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling keyword processing related to search indexing and querying, including tokenization, stemming, stop words filtering, and thesaurus expansion.

methods.name: getSeparators
methods.description: Returns the string of separator characters used to tokenize keywords.

methods.name: getStopWordBagOr
methods.description: Returns the property value for stop words used in OR search operations.

methods.name: getStopWordBagAnd
methods.description: Returns the property value for stop words used in AND search operations.

methods.name: getRemoveStems
methods.description: Indicates whether stemming should be removed based on configuration.

methods.name: getStemSet
methods.description: Builds and returns a set of suffix stems for stemming words during keyword processing.

methods.name: processForKeywords
methods.description: Processes an input string into keywords, applying separators, stop words, stemming, and prefix/suffix options for search or index purposes.

methods.name: processKeywordsForIndex
methods.description: Processes keywords specifically for indexing, with a predefined separator and stemming options.

methods.name: processForKeywords
methods.description: Overloaded method that processes keywords with detailed parameters including separators, stop words, stemming, and search flags.

methods.name: fixupKeywordSet
methods.description: Cleans up a set of keywords by filtering stop words, applying stemming, trimming short tokens, and optionally adding prefix/suffix wildcards, then groups/weights tokens in a map.

methods.name: makeKeywordSet
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a set of keywords based on separators, with optional modifications for search context (e.g., wildcards).

methods.name: fixKeywordsForSearch
methods.description: Prepares a keyword set for search by filtering, stemming, and adding wildcard prefixes/suffixes.

methods.name: expandKeywordForSearch
methods.description: Expands an entered keyword into a set of related keywords using thesaurus lookup, and indicates whether to replace the entered keyword based on thesaurus relationships.
